title: 3 cars, no signs. Who goes first? 🚗 #shorts
description:
Three cars reach a crossroads at the same time. Who goes first?
Comment A, B, C or D 👇

#roadrules #driving #drivingtest #quiz #noggin #shorts

scenes.question: Who goes first?
scenes.why: Everyone gives way to the right. Car A has nobody on its right, so it goes first. Then you, then Car B.

different: No one has automatic priority. Drivers must sort it out carefully.
The first car to arrive goes first. If you all arrive together, give way to the right.
They drive on the left, so you give way to the car on your left.
